declarations.type_signature: (view : CompleteView resolved) : Stage2.challenge? resolved 2 0 = some view.permutationColumns.std_alpha ∧ Stage2.challenge? resolved 2 1 = some view.permutationColumns.std_gamma

declarations.name: named_global_source
declarations.type_signature: (view : CompleteView resolved) : view.permutationColumns.gsum_result = view.base.group ∧ view.permutationColumns.im_direct_0 = view.base.direct 0 ∧ view.permutationColumns.im_direct_1 = view.base.direct 1 ∧ view.permutationColumns.im_direct_2 = view.base.direct 2 ∧ view.permutationColumns.im_direct_3 = view.base.direct 3 ∧ view.permutationColumns.im_direct_4 = view.base.direct 4 ∧ view.permutationColumns.im_direct_5 = view.base.direct 5

declarations.name: finalizer_coefficients
declarations.type_signature: (view : CompleteView resolved) (row : view.Index) : view.finalizerResidual row = 0 ↔ ∀ coordinate : Fin 3, (view.finalizerResidual row).coeff coordinate = 0
